03 / Research in the field

Expeditions

Underwater fieldwork documenting reefs and marine megafauna.

01

Bonaire Baseline Surveys

Bonaire · 2023 and 2026 · Reef mapping

Survey equipment and repeat photogrammetry with STINAPA; 18 reef sites surveyed in 2026.

02

Goto Terminal Survey

Bonaire · 2026 · Underwater inspection

Recording debris and reef condition beneath Bonaire’s Goto terminals for Rijkswaterstaat.

03

Reef Check California

Monterey, California · 2021 · Research diving

Underwater photogrammetry and 3D reconstruction supporting an urchin remediation study.

04

Marine Megafauna Foundation

Mozambique · Work with MMF, 2018–2019 · Marine megafauna observations

Research dives and ocean safaris collecting observations in coastal Mozambique.

Connecting fieldwork, research, and design

My work brings together experience in product design, underwater research, and scientific publishing. I'm interested in ecological change, deep time, and how people participate in thriving ecosystems across generations.
